# Web Shiroya — Machine-Readable Context for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Canonical URL: https://web.shiroya.in/

## Overview
Web Shiroya (VG Website Downloader) is a self-hosted developer utility and web interface designed to crawl, download, and archive complete websites for offline access.

## Architecture & Operational Model
1. **Target Crawling Engine**: Employs wget backend workers orchestrated via Node.js to recursively retrieve HTML documents, linked stylesheets, client-side scripts, and media assets.
2. **Real-Time Telemetry**: Streams live terminal logs and file counters to the web dashboard via Socket.IO.
3. **Automated Archive Packaging**: Compresses retrieved directory structures into downloadable ZIP archives with automatic job directory isolation.
4. **Frictionless Developer Tool**: No paywalls, subscriptions, or tracking cookies.
